unit.title: Equations, Formulas & Inverse Operations
unit.essential_question: How can equivalent operations preserve equality, reveal unknown quantities, and make formulas useful in many situations?
big_ideas: An equation states that two expressions have equal value.
A solution is a value that makes an equation true.
Applying the same valid operation to both sides preserves equality.
Inverse operations and structural simplification help isolate a variable.
Equations and formulas are meaningful only when variables, units, constraints, and checks are explicit.

lessons.title: Equality, Solutions & the Balance Model
objectives: Interpret an equation as a statement of equality.
Identify the left side, right side, variable, and solution.
Test possible solutions by substitution.
Use a balance model to explain equivalent equations.

lessons.title: One-Step Addition & Subtraction Equations
objectives: Solve equations using addition and subtraction.
Identify inverse operations.

Check solutions in the original equation.

lessons.title: One-Step Multiplication & Division Equations
objectives: Solve equations using multiplication and division.
Use reciprocals to isolate variables.
Solve equations with rational coefficients.
Check solutions with units and signs.

lessons.title: Two-Step Equations & Operation Order

lessons.title: Multi-Step Equations with Distribution & Like Terms
